totalCount.description: Total number of trackers or ads blocked since install

totalCookiePopUpsBlocked.description: Total number of cookie pop-ups blocked since install

isDefaultBrowser.description: Whether DuckDuckGo is the default browser. When false, the Protections Report offers to make it the default (sending 'protections_makeDefaultBrowser'); send an update through 'protections_onDataUpdate' once that changes. Omit if unknown: nothing is shown.
